svg.title: Five frequency and cochlear-place quotient DAGs feeding Whisper
svg.desc: Comparison of Mel, uniform subband, Goertzel, wavelet packet, and CAR-FAC cochlear frontends, each reduced to 80 probabilistic nodes before the same Whisper encoder.
svg.text: Five frequency/place quotient DAGs feeding the same Whisper encoder
Each lane has 80 quotient nodes. CAR-FAC uses cochlear place; the others use transform frequency. Nodes emit normalized energy mass and a 4-bit class.
